Grandma

Reviewed 2 months ago

#### Shockingly bad.

I bought myself this new box of crayons to celebrate the first back to school season since my grandson was born. These crayons are terrible. They smell wrong and they color poorly. I have never experienced wax flakes shedding off of a crayola crayon before, but these shed like crazy! I don’t know why crayola messed with the formula but I don’t imagine they will be the brand preferred by anyone by the end of the year.

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I love it because i want to draw a home with crayons. I love your crayons!

Spiderdan89

Reviewed 7 months ago

saj1624

Reviewed 11 months ago

#### Where has the quality gone?

Crayola Crayons have always been a dependable high quality crayon. The last years quality has gone down hill. This year takes the cake. I am an elementary school teacher and all the teachers agree that crayons are made thinner and break without effort. A crayon just needs to roll off the desk and it either snaps in half or the tip breaks off. For the students who take great pride in how they take care of the crayons - it's very upsetting. What was really an eye opener was finding an old box of crayons (about 5 or 6 years old ) in the back of my supply closet! The difference in quality was unmistakable. I can't believe that a company like Crayola has taken the cheap road. I know our school is looking for another brand of crayon that won't break so easily. It's frustrating to me as a teacher....but so much more frustrating for the kids trying to color! Come on Crayola! Bring back the quality !

Reply from Taylor 11 months ago

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with our 24 ct. Crayons. As an educator, your perspective is incredibly valuable, and we truly appreciate your dedication to your students and their creative experiences. We’re sorry to hear that the recent quality hasn’t met expectations. Durability is especially important in classroom settings, and we understand how frustrating it can be when crayons break easily—especially for young artists who take pride in caring for their supplies. Your comparison to older Crayola crayons is noted, and we’ll be sure to pass your feedback along to our product team. If you’d like to share more details or speak with someone directly, our team is available at 1-800-CRAYOLA. We hope to speak with you soon. -Taylor, Colorful Care Team

Regards,

Colorful Care Team

#### I thoughly dislike the current crayon quality

When did Crayola stop putting pigments into their products Seems like this art supply is a cheap replacement for the crayons I used when I taught art. Young children aren’t physically able to transfer these weak colors to a paper. I would rate it 0 if it was available!

Reply from Chris 1 year ago

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent experience with Crayola Crayons. Crayola is committed to maintaining the high standards that have made our products a trusted choice for generations. We utilize a strict quality control program to guarantee all Crayola products meet our performance standards. We understand how disappointing your experience was, and we are sorry your last set of crayons fell short of standard you should expect from our products. We would like the opportunity to learn more about your experience and do all we can to make this up to you. Please contact us at 1-800-CRAYOLA. We hope to get you back to coloring soon! – Chris, Colorful Care Team
